classification: prospective decision protocol; thresholds frozen before the new experiment results
purpose: Decide whether each shortlisted cold-start research direction is good, needs more work, or should be replaced.

global_rules.data: Use only metadata available by the prediction cutoff; define item warmth from training interactions only.
global_rules.evaluation: Report mixed full-catalog, cold-target, warm-target, and within-cold metrics separately.
global_rules.selection: Validation selects configurations; test/outer data must not select hyperparameters.
global_rules.inference: Use paired user-level or time-block uncertainty when the number of independent units permits it.
global_rules.runtime: Record wall time and peak memory. Serialize GPU jobs and prefer cached representations.
global_rules.stopping: A hard-gate failure completes that direction as a no-go; do not rescue it with an undeclared sweep.

rq1_offset_degeneracy.minimum_scope: At least three feasible global-time Amazon domains, followed by an impression-domain audit only if the Amazon mechanism generalizes and public data are practically obtainable.
hard_validity_gates: The offset sweep changes no within-warm or within-cold ordering; any detected change is an implementation failure.
All candidates obey query-time availability and seen-item masking.
The outer/test period is untouched by prior, temperature, or blend selection.
go_gates: At least two of three domains show a cold-target NDCG@10 span of at least 0.05 from the pool offset alone.
The same domains show the opposing warm-target response, with warm NDCG@10 span at least 0.02 or collapse to zero.
The direction of the cold/warm tradeoff is monotone apart from deterministic tie plateaus.
The effect is not confined to All_Beauty.
rq1_offset_degeneracy.wrapper_upgrade_gate: The validation-selected warm-safe integration policy has positive user-weighted mixed-traffic NDCG with a paired 95% interval excluding zero on at least two domains.

verdicts.good: Measurement contribution passes the go gates; wrapper is a method contribution only if its separate upgrade gate passes.
verdicts.needs_more_work: Measurement effect generalizes but the wrapper interval or impression-domain result is inconclusive.
verdicts.new_direction: The effect is tiny outside All_Beauty or disappears with valid availability/mixed-target evaluation.

rq2_selective_fir.screen_scope: One fixed seed on two metadata-rich temporal domains using matched data, initialization, optimization budget, and scoring calibration.
go_gates: Semantic-only FIR improves the predeclared primary cold metric over split-no-FIR on both domains.
Collaborative-only FIR is non-positive on average, or is materially smaller than semantic-only FIR on both domains.
Selective semantic FIR beats early-fused FIR on both domains.
The average selective-over-no-FIR cold NDCG@10 gain is at least 0.002 absolute and is not only a uniform cold-pool offset.
Mixed/warm utility remains within a predeclared 1% relative non-inferiority floor.
A shuffled-content or parameter-matched placebo does not reproduce the interaction.
rq2_selective_fir.confirmatory_upgrade: Only after all screen gates pass: run at least three seeds and four temporal domains with paired user/time-block inference.

verdicts.good: The multi-seed upgrade reproduces the full semantic/collaborative/early-fusion interaction.
verdicts.needs_more_work: The two-domain screen passes but the multi-seed or cross-domain interaction is heterogeneous.
verdicts.new_direction: Any core screen interaction gate fails.

rq3_anchored_cruot.screen_scope: Controlled paired manifolds with clean, outlier-contaminated, unmatched-mass, and semantic-shift regimes; out-of-sample targets only.
go_gates: Anchoring prevents the permutation/non-identifiability failure seen in the unanchored arm.
Under contamination or unmatched mass, anchored CR-UOT reduces out-of-sample mapping error by at least 10% relative to the strongest non-CR-UOT baseline in at least two shifted regimes.
The inferred mass deficit predicts per-item mapping error with absolute Spearman correlation at least 0.30.
The method does not materially underperform ridge/Procrustes on clean paired data.
The optimized implementation uses landmark/block memory rather than a dense full-catalog quadratic plan.
rq3_anchored_cruot.natural_upgrade_gate: Only after the synthetic gates pass: at least 5% relative within-cold NDCG@10 improvement on a natural strict-cold domain, with gains surviving affine score calibration.

verdicts.good: Synthetic gates and the natural upgrade gate pass.
verdicts.needs_more_work: Synthetic mechanism passes but natural ranking is inconclusive.
verdicts.new_direction: Synthetic recovery, mass-error diagnostic, or clean-data safety gate fails.
